html:
Greetings, Agents. 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Experts in magic and supernatural beings
have come together to fight against dangerous evil!
The theme of the October Update is the <Midnight Suns>. 

 

Doctor Strange who has come through death and time 
has gained new powers and Advanced to Tier-4!

 

Sister Grimm who can now utilize the abilities of the Staff of One better 
has acquired the abilities of Tier-3.

 

Doctor Voodoo has become a member of the Strange Academy 

where the best experts in magic belong to,
and is ready to deal with mystical phenomena with the new Super Hero Man-Thing.

 

Various improvements such as the addition of the new growth content, Team-Up Collection, 
and reward improvements for various game modes have been made
to support this team which deals with difficult problems, so don’t miss the changes! 

 


▣ One New Hero

 

Man-Thing, a Super Hero with everlasting healing abilities
and powerful strength has joined MARVEL Future Fight!  
* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms

 

Dive into the different story of the Midnight Suns Super Heroes!
Check out the abilities of 

Doctor Strange of <Death of Doctor Strange> who has come through death and time,
Sister Grimm <Runaways> who has acquired the powers of the great staff,
and Doctor Voodoo <Strange Academy> who has become one of the top experts of magic.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)      
* The three new uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <October Update Celebration Event>, 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Doctor Strange Tier-4

 

Doctor Strange is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
Check out his magic that has become stronger to fight against transcendental beings. 
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Sister Grimm Tier-3

 

Sister Grimm is now available for Tier-3 Advancement.
Check out the powerful magic cast with words and blood!

 

 

 

 

▣ Doctor Voodoo & Man-Thing Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the October Update, Doctor Voodoo and Man-Thing

will acquire Potential Awakening and Transcendence!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Team-Up Collection

 

Heroes have joined teams to accomplish special goals.
Complete collections and acquire various options that will help your battles.

 

 

* Team-Up Collection themes can be added through further updates.

 

1. Complete designated challenges to acquire the rewards and set the Team-Up option. 
- The Challenges will be unlocked in order from steps 1 to 10 after clearing the previous step.
- Acquire Collection Tokens for each theme by clearing the challenges.
* The upgrade status of trial Uniforms acquired through Guided Quests 
will not be applied to Team Up Collection challenges.

 

 

2. Only one Team-Up option can be applied for each of the 10 steps. 
Team-up options can be upgraded with Gold.
- Team-up options will only apply to the target theme/heroes.
- Team-up options will be applied to all game modes.
* Crystals will be spent when changing the applied option to another. 
* Agents can increase the level of Team-Up options even when they are not applied.  

 

 

 

3. Collection Tokens for each theme are used to upgrade the Collection option level. 
- Collection options will only apply to heroes of the target theme.
- Collection options will be applied to all game modes.
* The upgrade success rate will differ based on the Collection option level.

* When the same hero is set under multiple Team-Up Collection themes,
only the theme option with the highest collection option level will be applied.
 

 

* Only the option of the current level, not the sum, will be applied.
* Collection options will only apply to heroes of the target theme.
* Collection options will be applied to all game modes.

 

4.  Additional Collection Tokens for each theme can be acquired 
through Crystal or Package purchase at the Store after the October Update.

 


▣ Game Mode Reward Improvements 

 

1. The First Clear reward for Story: Ultimate difficulty has been improved.
- The rewards have been improved and items such as Tier-4 materials, 
Dimension Chest: 3★ Artifact, and Uniform Upgrade Ticket: Mythic have been added.  
- Check the First Clear reward by tapping the reward icon on the main screen of each theme.
* Only certain Exclusive Artifacts can be acquired from the Dimension Chest: 3★ Artifact.  
* The First Clear reward for Story: Ultimate difficulty themes will be reset after the update.

 

 

2. The Otherworld Battle Premium Battle Pass rewards will be improved.

 

[Sale Schedule] 
After the calculations and league progress of Otherworld Battle Season 4 has ended

 

[Changes]

* The price of the Premium Battle Pass will not be changed.
* Please check the components of the product in detail in-game.

 

3. The Alliance Tournament rank rewards have been improved.
* This will apply to the Alliance Tournament round that first begins after the October Update.
* One item will be acquired from the Alliance Tournament Chest based on the probabilities.
Please check the rewards in detail in-game.

 

 

 

4. ISO-8 rewards from Multiverse Invasion has been changed to Boost ISO-8.
- This applies to the basic rewards, VIP rewards, and S.H.I.E.L.D.’s Special Support rewards.

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Sister Grimm, Man-Thing, 
and Doctor Voodoo will be added after the October Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season 

the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.
          
​New Special Icons that will represent you have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, 
one as Otherworld Battle rewards, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[October Update New Special Icon]

            

 


▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms of the Midnight Suns theme.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The Auto Purchase On/Off feature has been added for 
Store → Dimension Chest → Artifact → Advanced Artifact Chest has been added. 
- The chest unpacking animation will not be displayed when auto-purchasing.

 

 

2. Applied game modes will be displayed when tapping 
the icon of some effects on the upper left side of the main lobby screen.

 

 

3. Agents can now move to the hero information screen 
by tapping the hero image on the main screen of the Guided Quest.

 

4. The UI and texts of the probabilities for the Comic Card content have been improved.

 

5. When there are two or more heroes in a team who are equipping a C.T.P. of Insight 
with different reforge options, both options will now be applied. 
- Target Reforge Option: 

Increases basic damage dealt to boss types, decreases additional pierce damage received

 

6. Some pattern effects of World Boss: Legend <Mephisto> not being displayed 
when setting the graphics option to very low has been fixed.

 

7. The meteorite not being destroyed in the meteorite destruction pattern that appears in the 

second phase of World Boss: Legend <Kang the Conqueror> when using the 5th active skill of 

Spider-Man (Miles Morales) <Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse> has been fixed.  
 

8. Pop-up products that are displayed under certain conditions 
will be displayed again to Agents who have not purchased the product.

 

9. The progress time of Multiverse Invasion has decreased from two minutes to one minute.
* Agents can receive a similar score even if the time has been reduced.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The ‘Additional Reward’ text being displayed on the upper side of the fixed reward when the 
fixed / additional rewards are the same in the Shadowland clear result screen has been fixed.

 

2. The text on the upper left side of the Store being displayed as Acquire / Upgrade Characters
when entering the Store through the main lobby screen - menu - Dimension Chest, 
returning to the lobby, and entering the Store again has been fixed.

 

3. The level and Tier of Potential Transcended heroes that can advance to Tier-4 not being 
upgraded further than level 70 with the Potential [+] button in the Marvel Universe has been fixed.

 

4. The image of some pop-up products has been fixed.

 

5. Some effects of the 5th active skill of Riri Williams <Black Panther: Wakanda Forever> 
being higher in level 5 than in level 6 has been fixed.
 
6. Enemy monsters not being generated in Story 8-2 
when using skills with a wide range in a specific location has been fixed. 

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
